mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carousel (id, title, pictureLogic, picturePath, linkUrl, sort, enabled, createTime) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{pictureLogic}, #{picturePath}, #{linkUrl}, #{sort}, #{enabled}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, pictureLogic, picturePath, linkUrl, sort, enabled, createTime FROM carousel ORDER BY sort ASC
SELECT id, title, pictureLogic, picturePath, linkUrl, sort, enabled, createTime FROM carousel WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC
